name: CSS Scroll Shadows
description: Scrollable containers that show soft affordance shadows at their top and bottom edges, only while more content hides in that direction. A native CSS Scroll Progress Timeline fades each shadow in and out, and a scroll-detection trick hides them entirely on containers that cannot scroll. Zero JavaScript.
usage: Include styles.css, add class="sds-scroller" to any vertically scrolling element and give it a height or max-height. The shadows appear and fade on their own; retheme per scroller with the --sds-shadow-rgb, --sds-shadow-alpha and --sds-shadow-size custom properties.
